items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: Buddy Manaday, Joe Watson, Yang Johnson.

ctx.x: Well, he ain't gonna do nothing. It won't do nothing but shock, but shock in a person's career. Peter Bokai. That's all it's gonna do. He didn't drink, I don't think. It is shock in your career. Yes, he did. It's detrimental. It's very detrimental. You don't know.

Chris Kelly. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Buddy Manaday, Joe Watson, Yang Johnson. And old Kid Punch. All them old fellas. Sam Bowman. And just drink with the song. Guy A. Butler rap is his name. But Punch doesn't drink anymore. He can.

No, he better quit. He can. Before I left here and he was staying in all them big markets and clothing store on Saturday night out on the balcony. He drank like a fish. Punch did. And Chris Kelly too. I remember all them old fellas.
